translation_notes: context shim: KTBS/SKOS are the real namespaces from ktbs/ktbs's lib/ktbs/namespace.py and lib/ktbs/utils.py; coerce_to_node/coerce_to_uri/parent_uri are a best-effort reconstruction (rdfrest has no PyPI release and its GitHub mirror has no source at any tag) -- see context.py header.

the two triple_add sequences that share subject self.uri or node are grouped into two @graph + +{ } islands (draft had used graph += g{ } per add, which is the add_isolated pattern for a fresh graph, not the shared-subject one; here it is a single Graph mutated by reference so @graph + +{ } is the direct match).
optimization_notes: optimized.py: little to compress, the region is mostly guards and the docstring. The three unconditional adds become one `graph += [...]` (still before the parameter loop, so a caller-supplied graph is left in the same partial state when a key holding '=' raises); `"%s=%s" % (key, value)` becomes an f-string; `not (t) in g` becomes `t not in g`. Every guard and raise is kept: parent is None, parameters is None, the trust/Method check, graph is None, the '=' check, the final assert.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: `@graph graph` + one `+{ }` for the batch; the parameter literal is an f-string plain literal in the island; `Literal(label)` becomes `{label}` (label is a str in the API, and node() equals Literal() on a str or a Literal); the Method membership test becomes `not m{ {parent} a {KTBS.Method} }(self.state)` (call suffix: self.state is not the current graph). KTBS stays interpolated: it is the project's namespace object, imported from context. No exception to the symmetry.
As in the translation, `@graph graph` adds the block's prefixes to a caller-supplied graph's bindings (record ldpy/027); its triples are the same.
header_optimization_notes: Python: URIRef goes from rdflib, parent_uri and extend_api from the context import.
LD Python: Literal, RDF and URIRef go from rdflib, parent_uri, extend_api and SKOS from the context import; @prefix rdf: goes (the region writes `a`), @prefix skos: stays.
